tns:patch.author: bmokandu
tns:patch.description: Manually add conflicting M&E section to DB if not exists.

script.lang:
INSERT INTO AMP_ONEPAGER_SECTION (feature_name, is_visible, order_index) SELECT 'org.dgfoundation.amp.onepager.components.features.me.singlecountry.AmpMEFormSectionFeature', false, 17 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AMP_ONEPAGER_SECTION WHERE feature_name = 'org.dgfoundation.amp.onepager.components.features.me.singlecountry.AmpMEFormSectionFeature' );
INSERT INTO AMP_ONEPAGER_SECTION (feature_name, is_visible, order_index) SELECT 'org.dgfoundation.amp.onepager.components.features.sections.AmpMEFormSectionFeature', false, 17 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AMP_ONEPAGER_SECTION WHERE feature_name = 'org.dgfoundation.amp.onepager.components.features.sections.AmpMEFormSectionFeature' );
